title: BioIVT: a Response to therapy question after Therapy status
description: Adds a Response to therapy question (RECIST categories) after the Therapy status question and its Other box. Step 3 of the ordered therapy chain: anchored on the status Other box, so it lands after it.
rationale: Disease response is the other thing the old free-text answers held (stable, progressive disease, complete response).
source: BioIVT Option C update; approved by Dan

history.note: Stage group and therapy outcome update.
